ctx.x: When I was a kid, my Dad used to have a lot of Classical records. We had a phonograph. But I...

But I mean, the average New Orleans musician will know Louis' record of so-and-so, he'll know Jack Teagarden's record of so-and-so, Bix Beiderbecke's record, or even Dizzy Gillespie's record, no matter what. But if you ask him about Classical things... You never said you listened to Classical music at all.

I never did. There was a few Classical records that I had. I remember when I went out as a kid, I had to play the pretty thing on that tune...[SINGS REFRAIN] -- Rose of Washington Square, that a symphony had made. And another tune called Mickey that was from one of the operas or something. I remember a couple of those
